message.content: {"query":"WITH samsung_tdocs AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.node_id FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY s ON s.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=s.dst_id WHERE c.companyName='Samsung'), agreement_linked AS (SELECT DISTINCT st.node_id FROM samsung_tdocs st JOIN rel_REFERENCES r ON r.dst_id=st.node_id JOIN Agreement a ON a.node_id=r.src_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agreement_linked) AS agreementLinkedTdocCount, json_object('numerator',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agreement_linked),'denominator',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM samsung_tdocs)) AS agreementLinkedTdocShare","abstain":false}
